COVERAGE_SUMMARY: 3 UI-testable fallback stories in scope from the linked initiative; 1 spike excluded.
OUT_OF_SCOPE: Backend impersonation endpoint internals, VPN/network enablement, internal tooling entrypoints, and non-UI migration spikes.
DEV_EVIDENCE: Available - PR 510 covers login and FE-to-BE connection via Jira comment + GitHub PR evidence; PR 557 search evidence covers impersonation UI frame/banner for G2-21326.
GAPS_SUMMARY: Epic has no direct child stories on the epic-link query, so scope is reconstructed from linked initiative G2-15882. G2-21326 AC is terse and relies on PR summary for banner/frame specifics.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: NAP impersonation login entry page is reachable for an authorized internal agent.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Open the NAP impersonation login entry point.
Confirm the impersonation login form loads without redirecting to the standard customer login.
Verify the page reflects the normal site shell and is usable by an internal agent.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Authorized agents can reach the NAP impersonation login form.
The page loads with the expected site layout and without broken states.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: MRP impersonation login entry page is reachable for an authorized internal agent.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Open the MRP impersonation login entry point.
Confirm the impersonation login form loads for the MRP brand context.
Verify the page remains consistent with the brand experience.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Authorized agents can reach the MRP impersonation login form.
The page loads in the correct brand context and remains usable.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: The impersonation form accepts agent credentials and the customer account identifier to impersonate.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Populate the impersonation form with valid agent credentials and a valid customer email or account identifier.
Submit the form once fields are complete.
Confirm the form accepts the values and starts the impersonation flow.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The form exposes the required input fields for agent authentication and customer targeting.
Submitting valid values starts impersonation without validation regressions.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: A NAP impersonation login starts a customer session and opens the customer account view with accurate customer data.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Complete impersonation for a NAP customer account.
Confirm the resulting session lands in the customer's account context.
Validate that key customer data shown in account areas matches the impersonated account.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The agent enters the customer's NAP session successfully.
Customer data shown after login matches the impersonated account.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: A MRP impersonation login starts a customer session and opens the customer account view with accurate customer data.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Complete impersonation for an MRP customer account.
Confirm the resulting session lands in the customer's account context.
Validate that key customer data shown in account areas matches the impersonated account.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The agent enters the customer's MRP session successfully.
Customer data shown after login matches the impersonated account.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: The session redirects the agent to the customer's last used channel and language after successful impersonation.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Use a customer account with a known last used brand locale.
Complete impersonation from the login form.
Confirm the post-login page opens in the expected channel and language combination.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Successful impersonation redirects to the expected last used channel.
The rendered language and brand context match the customer's stored preference.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Existing customer wishlist and cart content remain available during impersonation across account and checkout flows.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Impersonate a customer who already has saved wishlist items and cart items.
Inspect account areas and proceed into checkout entry points where applicable.
Confirm existing saved items remain visible and usable during the impersonated session.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Customer wishlist and cart content persist when impersonation begins.
Account and checkout flows continue to use the customer's existing state without unexpected resets.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: The UI clearly indicates when impersonation mode is active.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Start an impersonation session on both NAP and MRP.
Observe the account or shell UI immediately after login and while navigating relevant pages.
Confirm that the active impersonation indicator remains visible and understandable.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
An active impersonation indicator is visible after login.
The indicator remains clear enough for agents to distinguish impersonated sessions from standard customer browsing.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: The impersonated experience preserves the production site look and feel while allowing the agent to act as the customer.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
From a successful impersonation session, navigate through representative account and checkout entry points.
Compare the UI behavior with a normal customer journey for the same brand.
Confirm the agent can continue the customer journey without broken impersonation context.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The impersonated journey matches the normal site presentation closely enough for business use.
The agent can continue through account and checkout without losing impersonation context.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Persisted wishlist and cart data may be the first place impersonation context drift becomes visible.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Start impersonation for a customer with pre-existing wishlist and cart data, then compare visible saved items and cart content before and after entering checkout-adjacent flows.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Existing customer state remains intact across the impersonated session without cross-user leakage or empty-state regressions.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Derived from PR 510 testing note that wishlist and cart items should persist for the impersonated customer.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Redirect logic can land the agent in the wrong brand or locale if lastUsedData is stale or incomplete.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Use accounts with different stored brand and language histories, repeat impersonation, and verify the final landing context for each.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Each impersonation lands deterministically on the expected brand and language combination.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Brand variance and auth/session continuity risk inferred from the redirection AC and epic objective.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: The impersonation banner must remain obvious enough during navigation so the agent does not mistake the session for normal customer browsing.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Navigate between account and checkout-relevant pages during an active impersonation session and watch whether the visual indicator stays present and understandable.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: The indicator remains visible through the critical journey and continues to distinguish impersonated mode clearly.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Supported by the PR 557 search result describing an impersonation banner/frame with highlight treatment.
